title: ci: add artifact build, cosign signing, SBOM provenance and release manifests for private-installer
author: Priya Kapoor
description: This PR wires up CI pipeline steps to produce signed release artifacts and accompanying provenance for the private-installer release. Motivation: customers running Private deployments require verifiable release artifacts (signed installers, SBOMs and reproducible release-manifests) to meet compliance and offline-install requirements. What this PR does: 1) adds build scripts to produce installer artifacts and canonical SBOMs (syft) during CI; 2) integrates cosign-based signing and public key publishing to GCS; 3) emits a release-manifests.yaml that enumerates artifact checksums, SBOM locations, and signatures for each release artifact; 4) updates Helm chart metadata and terraform module version pinning to match release layout; 5) adds a verification job that validates signatures and provenance as a gated check before merge. Checklist: build artifacts generation tested locally; SBOM format validated with syft; cosign signatures verified with test key; release-manifests schema validated; docs/RELEASE.md updated with install/verify steps; e2e verification job added to CI. Impact: backwards compatible for existing installs; improves supply-chain auditability for Private deployments. Related: ENG-2345, SUP-789. Merge method: squash.
